terroir_manifesto.heading: Fire, Earth & Forgotten Flavors
terroir_manifesto.subheading: We cook with honesty. What local farmers and coastal day-boats harvest by dawn, our wood-fired hearth transforms by evening.
terroir_manifesto.lead_paragraph: At Kavya, dining is rooted in elemental techniques: natural charcoal smoke, Sahyadri mountain herbs, and patient slow-cooking over live flames without microwaves or artificial additives.

chef_story.heading: Respecting The Flame & Old Recipes
chef_story.subheading: Classical culinary discipline meets Maharashtra's vibrant hearth cooking traditions.
chef_story.lead_quote: We do not cover food in heavy cream or artificial sauces. We let the fire, the cast-iron kadai, and authentic local spices bring out the true character of every ingredient.
paragraphs: After leading kitchens at top fine-dining establishments in Mumbai and New Delhi, Chef Vikram Shinde returned home to Pune with a clear vision: to celebrate the diverse culinary heritage of Maharashtra and the Konkan coast over live wood fire.

Every morning, our team gathers around the wood-fired hearth to check the day's fresh deliveries: pomfret and scallops driven up fresh from Ratnagiri, seasonal greens wet with dawn dew from Junnar farms, and cold-pressed oils from local village oil mills.

We cook without commercial gas or microwaves in our main kitchen theater. Every dish, reduction, and gentle sear is made over natural babool wood and charcoal embers, guided by touch, timing, and a deep love for Indian flavors.

testimonials.title: Praised by Diners & Food Critics
testimonials.subtitle: Genuine words from discerning diners and leading culinary reviewers.

reviews.quote: Chef Vikram Shinde elevates everyday regional notes like kokum, dagad phool, and jaggery into an astonishing fine-dining experience.
reviews.full_critique: Every course in the tasting menu shows remarkable depth. The balance of wood smoke, coastal sourness, and slow-braised richness sets a benchmark for modern Indian dining in Maharashtra.

reviews.quote: Kavya Hearth & Cellar brings pure theatre to Pune without any gimmicky tricks. The wood-fired seafood and lamb are unforgettable.
reviews.full_critique: From the open hearth counters to the non-alcoholic botanical tea pairing curated by Ananya Deshmukh, Kavya represents genuine Indian hospitality and culinary mastery.

reviews.quote: The single most exciting restaurant opening in Pune this decade. Warm, generous, and deeply memorable.
reviews.full_critique: Sitting near the charcoal hearth, one watches a skilled team cooking with calm focus. Flawless taste and impeccable service from the first starter to the dessert.
